remarks:
A rare opportunity to own a distinctive three-story brick mixed-use property at 413 Genesee Street, located near Buffalo’s historic Broadway Market area and just seconds from downtown. 

The property is a fixer-upper and will require renovation and improvements, making it well suited for a buyer looking to restore, reposition, and unlock the potential of a unique historic Buffalo building. Its solid brick construction, three levels of flexible mixed-use space, and proximity to downtown provide an exciting foundation for redevelopment. Convenient access to NY Route 33 and I-190, along with a direct route along Genesee Street toward Buffalo Niagara International Airport, adds to the property’s accessibility.

Whether envisioned as a residential apartments, bar and restaurant, live/work investment, entertainment venue, or creative mixed-use redevelopment, 413 Genesee Street offers a compelling combination of history, character, location, and potential. 

Square footage base on the City of Buffalo's Assessment & Taxation Department Property Record Card. Property and contents are being sold in “as-is” condition.
Property is also listed as "Commercial" on MLS as B1710481
